title: Seagrove "2 Palms" 41 East Grove Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS STEPS AWAY!- 4 adult bikes- Spacious back yard- Parking for 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover 2 Palms, a delightful single-story haven in the heart of Seagrove Beach—perfect for a small family escape. With 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, this charming home sleeps up to 4 guests in coastal comfort. Spend mornings biking along scenic coastal paths with the provided adult bikes, unwind in the afternoons on the screened-in porch, and let the kids enjoy evenings in the spacious backyard. Best of all, the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters are steps away!Set along Florida’s emerald shores, this modern coastal cottage welcomes guests with a cheerful front porch and cozy outdoor seating that’s perfect for embracing the laid-back beach lifestyle. Inside, the open-concept design merges the dining and kitchen areas with the sun-soaked living space, which is great for gathering with friends and family. Under warm wood beams, this galley kitchen invites the chef of the group to whip up delicious home-cooked meals on high-end appliances. Stretch out on the expansive built-in bench, seamlessly connecting the 2 dining tables and 4 chairs for casual meals, lively conversations, or a family game night. Kick back and relax in the bright and airy living room, while watching TV on the plush white sofa and 2 matching armchairs. As the day ends, choose between 2 lovely guest bedrooms with a king bed and a queen bed, respectively. Both bedrooms share a bathroom with a walk-in shower. The laundry room makes it easy to refresh beach gear for tomorrow’s big adventure. At the heart of the home is the private screened-in porch, offering cushioned outdoor seating under a ceiling fan, paired with a backyard for kids to play, throw a frisbee, or gather for a family picnic—all located near the soothing sounds of Gulf waves.2 Palms is a vibrant coastal paradise in the heart of Seagrove Beach. With on-site parking for 1 vehicle in the driveway and 1 streetside, plus 4 complimentary bikes, it’s easy to explore local gems like Village Market, Grayton Beach State Park, and The Perfect Pig. For beach access, head to Holly Street and take a right. Then, turn right on 30A, and Scenic 395 Access is on the left, less than 1 minute away! Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 4):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
